lines.japanese:
……あれは、もう何年前のことだろう。
　ここにやってきて、ずっと部屋に閉じこもっていたあと。
　使用人の女の子と仲良くなって、ようやく外で遊ぶようになったあとだったろうか。
―――ごめんなさい、兄さん。
　誰もいない庭で、あきははとうとつに泣き始めた。
　何を謝っているのか問いただしても、秋葉はただごめんなさいと繰り返すだけだった。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
How many years ago was that?
It happened after I first came here and spent so long shut away in my room.
Perhaps it was after I befriended the servant girl and finally began playing outside.
―――I’m sorry, Brother.
In the empty garden, Akiha suddenly began to cry.
No matter how often I asked what she was apologizing for, all she did was repeat that she was sorry.

---I'm sorry, Nii-san.
In the empty courtyard, Akiha suddenly started to cry.
Even when I asked what she was apologizing for, she just kept apologizing.

lines.japanese:
―――わたしたちが、兄さんからみんなうばってしまったから。
　秋葉の泣いている理由は、そのときの自分にはもう終わってしまった出来事にすぎなかった。
　……恨んでいないといえば嘘になる。
　けど、それはまだ六歳ぐらいの女の子が責任を感じて、必死に謝ってくるような事ではないはずだ。
　第一、 秋葉は何も悪くはなかった。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Because we took everything away from you.
By then, whatever had made Akiha cry was already over and done with as far as I was concerned.
It would be a lie to say I felt no resentment.
But it was not something a little girl of six should feel responsible for, much less apologize so desperately over. Akiha had done nothing wrong.

In the first place, she didn't do anything wrong.

―――ごめんなさい。
ごめんなさい、兄さん。
　……どうして気がつかなかったんだろう。
　秋葉は初めて会った時から、いつも俺に謝っていた。
　この広い屋敷の中で、ただ一人自分のために泣いてくれた少女。
―――ありがとう。
けど、もういいんだ。
　笑って、秋葉の頭をなでた。
　秋葉はきょとんとした顔でこっちを見上げる。
　その時に、初めて、強く思った。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
―――I’m sorry. I’m so sorry, Brother.
How had I never noticed?
From the first day we met, Akiha had always been apologizing to me.
In that vast estate, she was the only girl who cried for my sake.
―――Thank you. But it’s all right now.
I smiled and stroked Akiha’s hair.
She stared up at me, bewildered.
And for the first time, I felt it with all my heart.

　これからは、ボクらは兄妹なんだから。
　……嬉しそうに笑った秋葉の顔を覚えている。

　本当の家族になると。
　自分はお兄ちゃんなんだから、どんなことがあっても秋葉を守ると誓った。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
―――You don’t have to cry, Akiha.
From now on, you and I are brother and sister.
I remember the joy in Akiha’s smile.
That was when I swore we would become a true family.
I was her big brother.
Whatever happened, I would protect her.

lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:

There was a time when I cherished it like a dream.

　朝の光で目が覚めた。
　自分が殺人鬼ではないとはっきり解ったおかげか、昨夜は殺人の夢は見なかった。
「……けど、なんか……」
　懐かしい夢を見たような気がする。
　まだ俺も秋葉も幼くて、自分たちがどんな関係なのか解っていなかったころの夢―――
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Mm…”
Morning light wakes me.
Perhaps because I finally know I’m not a murderer, I had no dreams of killing last night.
“But something…”
I have the feeling I dreamed of something long ago.
From when Akiha and I were still children and did not understand what we were to each other―――

「志貴さま、昨夜はいつの間に戻られたのですか？
　秋葉さまが居間でお待ちしていたのですが」
「…………ああ、昨日は疲れててさ。
秋葉が居間にいるっていうのは解ってたんだけど、そのまま自分の部屋に戻ったんだ」
　そう答えて、自分に対する嫌悪感で気が滅入った。
　……昨日の夜。
　シエル先輩と別れた後、屋敷に戻ってきた俺は秋葉から逃げるように自分の部屋に戻ってしまった。

lines.maoEnglish:
“When did you return last night, Master Shiki? Miss Akiha was waiting for you in the sitting room.”
“Oh, I was tired yesterday. I knew Akiha was there, but I went straight back to my room.”
The answer leaves me sick with self-loathing.
…Last night, after parting from Ciel,
I returned to the estate and went straight to my room to avoid Akiha.

『おまえが吸血鬼なのか』なんて事を秋葉に聞けるわけがないし、もしその答えが最悪なものだったら、どうしていいか分からない。
　そんな事を思っている以上、秋葉と顔を合わせてまともに会話ができるはずがなかった。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
For all my frantic insistence that Ciel was wrong, I was too afraid to confront Akiha myself.
I could never ask her outright whether she was the vampire; if her answer was the worst possible one, I would have no idea what to do.
With thoughts like that in my head, there was no chance I could face her and carry on a normal conversation.

「翡翠、悪いんだけど今日は一緒にいてくれないか。
うちを出るまででいいから、傍にいてほしい」
「――――――――」

俺を見る。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Is Akiha already in the sitting room?”
“Yes, Master Shiki; she has been waiting for you for some time.”
“I see. That is a problem.”
Right now, I have no confidence that I can be alone with her and behave as usual. Even an ordinary greeting feels beyond me.
“Hisui, could you stay with me today? Only until I leave the house; I would like you beside me.”
“――――――――”
Her expression does not change,
but Hisui catches her breath and stares at me.

　私、あの頃はすぐに泣いてしまう子だったでしょう？

lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Do you drag up the whole past every time you dream about being a child?”
“But it made me nostalgic. Don’t you remember that day beneath the tree, when you called me Akiha for the first time and stroked my hair?
I cried at the slightest thing in those days, didn’t I? Everyone else would fuss over me because they didn’t know what to do, but you were the only one who felt sad with me. It made me cry even harder—but afterward, I truly felt as though nothing sad could ever happen again.
Ever since then, I―――Brother? What is wrong; do you feel ill…?”

“Akiha, you――――”
“Brother? Why are you looking at me like that?”
“Why? Why do you remember, Akiha? Everyone else has forgotten Ciel, so why are you the only one who remembers?!”
“What――――?”
Akiha’s expression freezes.
Then, as though trying to hide something, she averts her eyes.

“――――――――”
Akiha does not answer.
Her silence is answer enough.

lines.japanese:
「秋葉……！
　黙ってないで答えてくれ、おまえは初めから先輩が吸血鬼を退治するためにいる人だって知ってたから、ずっと先輩のことを毛嫌いしてたっていうのか……！」
「吸血鬼って、兄さん――――」
　呆然と俺を見る秋葉。
　……その顔は吸血鬼という単語に驚いているというより、俺が吸血鬼なんて言葉を口にする事に驚いているようだった。
「……秋葉。
黙ってないで答えてくれ。
そうしないと俺は、おまえを―――」
　信じることが、できなくなる。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, answer me! Did you hate her all this time because you knew from the beginning that she was here to hunt vampires…?!”
“Vampires, Brother――――”
Akiha stares at me in shock.
Her expression suggests not that the word itself surprises her, but that she is stunned to hear me speak it.
“Akiha. Please answer me. Otherwise I will―――”
I will no longer be able to trust you.

lines.japanese:

私にはあの人が最初から違うひとだと解っていました。
あの人が初対面の人間に暗示をかけている事に気がついたから、あの人のことは信用できなかったんです」
「……？
　初対面の人に暗示をかけてるって、先輩が……？」
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yes, Brother. I knew from the beginning that there was something different about her. I noticed she was planting suggestions in everyone she met, so I never trusted her.”
“Planting suggestions…? Ciel was doing that?”
lines.mao_english:

「ええ。

　私は暗示にはかからなかったから、あの人がどこか異状な人だと気がついてたんです」
　弁解するように秋葉は言う。
　けど、秋葉は肝心なことを言ってくれない。
　誰もがかかっていたというシエル先輩の暗示とやらに、どうして秋葉はかからなかったのかという事を。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yes. That is why no one even found a name like Ciel strange, remember? The suggestion did not work on me, so I could tell there was something wrong about her.”
Akiha says it almost defensively.
But she still avoids the one thing that matters.
Why had she alone resisted a suggestion that affected everyone else?

lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Everyone under the influence of her suggestion forgot that Ciel had ever existed the moment it was lifted. I was never under its influence, so naturally I still remember her now.”
“I understand that. But why, Akiha? Why did the suggestion not work on you?”
“―――That is, well―――”
“Right. The Tohnos are not normal. Because they are not normal, Ciel’s suggestion did not work on you, did it?”
lines.mao_english:

“I understand that. But why, Akiha? Why did the suggestion not work on you?”
“―――That is, well―――”
“Right. The Tohnos are not normal. Because they are not normal, Ciel’s suggestion did not work on you, did it?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"When the hypnosis is removed, those people affected by it will forget the person called Ciel.
Since I was never affected in the first place, even though it has been removed, I remember her."
"…… I get it.
But Akiha, why weren't you affected?"
"---Well, that's---"
"…… I see.
Those of the Tohno bloodline aren't normal.
Because of that, Senpai's hypnosis was ineffective."

　赤く染まった教室で、俺たちは互いの顔を見つめ合う。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother, how do you know that?”
“Isn’t it obvious? I’m not normal either.”
With that, I rise from my chair.
Akiha stares at me in shock; then, her face settling into grim resolve, she stands as well.
―――An empty classroom.
In the room bathed red by the setting sun, we stand facing one another.

lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ciel told me. She said everyone in the Tohno family has some sort of special power… and that some of them lost control of themselves and killed people.”
“…”
“But I cannot believe it. I do not want to.”
“…”
“Tell me, Akiha. You are not―――a vampire, are you?”
Akiha gives no answer. Her eyes merely narrow with pain.

「―――なんとか言えよ。
なんで黙っているんだ秋葉……！」
　沈黙が苦しくて、そう怒鳴りつけていた。
　……ほんの少しの静寂のあと。
　秋葉は、何事もなかったかのような優雅さで、窓際まで歩き出した。
　長い髪が赤い夕焼けに透けている。
　赤い、髪をなびかせて、秋葉はくるりと振り返った。
lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
――――Why?
Why can she not deny it, even if she has to lie―――
“―――Say something. Why are you silent, Akiha…!?”
The silence is unbearable, and I find myself shouting at her.
After a brief stillness.
Akiha walks to the window with all her customary grace, as though nothing happened.
Her long hair shines translucent in the crimson sunset.
That red hair streams behind her as she turns to face me.

lines.label: s365
lines.maoEnglish:
“Answer me, Brother. If I were an ogre that drank human blood, what would you do?”
“―――Akiha, that is――――”
“If I admitted it, Akiha wouldn’t have to keep smothering herself anymore. Do you understand, Brother?
I could give up this silly pride and finally be honest with myself.”
She looks up at me through eyes at once ferocious and cruelly amused.
A shiver runs through me.
Though Akiha is looking up, her cold, quiet force makes me feel as though I were the one beneath her.

　高い気温と厭な予感が、夜の闇をガラスのようにはりつめさせている。
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
　荒い息遣いのまま階段をのぼりきって、廊下を歩く。
　……背筋が痛い。
　厭な空気は、秋葉の部屋に近づくたびに重くなっていく。

lines.maoEnglish:
I climb the stairs.
The heat and my sense of foreboding draw the darkness taut as glass.
―――Hah, hah, hah.
Still breathing hard, I reach the landing and move down the hall.
Pain needles my spine.
The foul pressure in the air grows heavier with every step toward Akiha’s room.

―――――闇。
　窓からさしこむ月光だけが、かろうじて部屋の様子を明らかにしている。
　その青い闇の中、倒れこんでいる秋葉の姿があった。
「秋葉――――！」
　かけつけて抱き起こす。
「…………………」
　秋葉は気を失っているのか、ぴくりとも動かない。
ただ、その小ぶりな胸がかすかに上下していて、息がある事だけが読み取れた。

lines.maoEnglish:
―――――Darkness.
Only the moonlight through the window gives the room any shape.
In that blue darkness, Akiha lies collapsed.
“Akiha――――!”
I rush to her and lift her into my arms.
“…”
Whether unconscious or worse, she does not move. Only the faint rise and fall of her chest tells me she is still breathing.

“Yes. It has been almost an hour since we arrived, and Master Shiki has done nothing but stand in place.”
“I see.”
Leaving Akiha wounded before me and doing nothing was unforgivable.
Far from protecting her, I might as well have been the one who hurt her.

lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
This is hopeless.
Now that we are face-to-face, I cannot think of a single thing to say.
Being in Akiha’s bedroom already has me tense, and she looks so terribly frail that my chest tightens.
“―――――――”
Neither of us speaks as we stare at each other.

「……何も聞かないんですね、兄さんは。
私、これでも覚悟していたんですけど」
　穏やかな声で、秋葉は言った。
「……そうだな。
たしかに聞きたい事は色々あるよ。
けど、それは秋葉が元気になったら聞くから。
今はただ、秋葉の顔を見に来ただけなんだ」
「そう。

　私ね、解らない事があると怒りっぽくなるんです。

lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
“You are not going to ask me anything, Brother? I prepared myself for this.”
Akiha’s voice is gentle.
“I do have plenty of questions. But they can wait until you are well. Right now, I only came to see your face. That is all.”
“I see. But I have questions for you. When there is something I do not understand, I become irritable. Unless I hear the answers from you, I will not be able to sleep in peace.”
“All right. You are the patient, so you get special treatment. Ask me anything.”

Perhaps Akiha’s manner is rubbing off on me.

「……それじゃあ聞きますね。
　兄さんは吸血鬼っていう言葉を使っていたでしょう？
　それはシエルから教えられた事なんですか？
　それとも兄さん本人から出た言葉なんですか？」
「……両方、かな。
俺さ、どうしてか眠ると人を殺して血を吸う夢を見てたんだ。
　それでてっきり自分が殺人鬼なのかなって思ってたんだけど、シエル先輩が誤解をといてくれた」

兄さんはシキの意識と同調してしまうんですね。

“Then let me ask.”
“You used the word vampire, did you not? Did you learn that from Ciel? Or did the word come from you?”
“Both, I suppose. Whenever I slept, I kept dreaming that I was murdering people and drinking their blood.
I thought I might be the killer, but Ciel cleared up that misunderstanding.”
“I see. Your mind synchronizes with SHIKI, Brother. That is why―――you asked me that question at school?”

I never noticed them because Father must have placed some kind of suggestion on me.

lines.japanese:
「……兄さん。
貴方は八年前、シキに殺されかけたんです。
シキは遠野の血が濃いという方ではなかったのですけど、本当に突然、遠野寄りのモノになってしまった。
　遠野の血は旧い生き物の血で、理性より本能を優先させてしまいます。
その血が全身にめぐってしまったシキは、その場に居あわせた兄さんに襲いかかってしまったんです」
　……それはシキから聞いた。
　この胸の傷は事故なんかじゃなくて、アイツにつけられた物なんだと。
lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Brother, eight years ago SHIKI nearly killed you. His Tohno blood was not considered particularly strong, but without warning he became something closer to the Tohno side.
The Tohno blood comes from ancient creatures and makes instinct take precedence over reason. Once that blood flooded SHIKI’s body, he attacked you simply because you happened to be there.”
SHIKI told me that much himself.
The scar on my chest came from him, not from any accident.

“That is right. Akiha, what happened to your hair? It was bright red before, but now it is black again. What does that mean?”

I do not want anything as incomprehensible as the Tohno blood to stain her.

Akiha explains it calmly, without resentment toward anyone.

“Yes. Unlike SHIKI, I cannot create others like myself. I am a creature that only takes.”
Akiha lowers her eyes.
To me, though, that is a salvation.
After all―――it only means her diet is a little different.

兄さんも疲れているでしょう？」

秋葉が眠るまで傍にいるから」
「……わかりました。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Is there anything I can do for you?”
“Please return to your room and rest. You must be tired too, Brother.”
“Idiot.”
It is the only answer I can manage.
“Just lie down. I will stay beside you until you fall asleep.”
“Very well. If you insist, Brother, I will allow myself to depend on you.”

……言って、秋葉はベッドに横になった。
　砂が落ちていくような時間のあと。
　秋葉は静かに、ゆっくりと眠りに落ちていった。
　安らかな秋葉の寝顔。
　それを、飽きる事なく、ただ見守り続けた。
lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
With that, Akiha lies down.
Time trickles past like sand.
Quietly, slowly, she drifts into sleep.
Her sleeping face is peaceful.
I watch it without ever tiring of the sight.

lines.japanese:
「起きてます。
秋葉の看病ですか、琥珀さん？」
「はい、熱を測ろうと思いまして。
志貴さん、申し訳ありませんけど……」
「あ、すみません。
すぐに席を外します」
　椅子から立ちあがる。

「……ありがとう。
ごめんな、秋葉」

lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
“I am awake. Are you here to look after Akiha, Kohaku?”
“I need to take her temperature. Master Shiki, I am sorry, but…”
“Oh, of course. I will leave right away.”
I rise from the chair.
Before leaving, I look once more at Akiha’s sleeping face.
“Thank you. I am sorry, Akiha.”
I whisper the words and leave her bedroom.

lines.japanese:
……琥珀さんに秋葉の事をまかせて、廊下を歩く。
　これでしばらくは安心のハズなのに、不安の翳りは消えてくれなかった。
　シキがまだ生きている、なんていう事はどうでもいい問題だ。
　気にかかるのは一つだけ。
　……ずっと秋葉の寝顔を見つめていたけど。
　あいつの髪の色は、何時間経っても、もとの黒に戻ってはくれなかった。
lines.label: s373
lines.maoEnglish:
Leaving Akiha in Kohaku’s care, I walk down the corridor.
I ought to be able to rest easy for a while, yet the shadow of anxiety refuses to lift.
SHIKI’s survival hardly matters.
Only one thing troubles me.
I watched Akiha sleep for hours.
Her hair never returned to its original black.

Things should be fine for now, but I still feel uncomfortable.
